title: Pilot evidence-linked workstream digests
description: Implement the final approved TASK-277 compact-memory experiment after source-aware fingerprints are proven. Generate one bounded workstream digest only when several related released tasks form a mature capability, preserving decisions, repeated failures, key files, open risks, and backlinks to canonical evidence. Treat the digest as a retrieval projection, never project truth.
acceptance_criteria: Pilot eligibility requires a declared threshold of related released tasks and one bounded mature workstream.
The digest preserves decisions, repeated failures, key files, unresolved risks, and backlinks to canonical task, submission, review, and source evidence.
Stale, contradictory, or missing evidence is surfaced rather than synthesized into an unquestioned fact.
A frozen evaluation measures required-fact retention, source traceability, stale-claim detection, and token reduction against raw context.
The pilot remains noncanonical and includes explicit refresh, invalidation, independent review, and rollback rules before any production proposal.
